body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not provide data on the extent to which CCDF providers charge families additional amounts above the required co-payment (including data on the size and frequency of such amounts), as required by 98.45(b)(5). (Plan Question 3.1.2eii) Overall Target Completion Date: 05/30/2025 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Arkansas launched a new eligibility system 12/4/2024. All CCDF providers are now required to acknowledge if they are changing families additional amounts above the required co- payment. 12/04/2025 2 Our IT department will also be updating the system to include the size and frequency of the amount. 05/30/2025

body: Reason(s) for non-compliance: • The Lead Agency does not pay all provider types prospectively or alternatively does not demonstrate that it is not a generally-accepted practice for all provider types, as required by 98.45(m)(1). (Plan Question 4.4.1a). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through July 31, 2026. • The Lead Agency does not pay based on enrollment or alternatively does not provide justification that this is impracticable or is not a generally-accepted practice, as required by 98.45(m)(2). (Plan Question 4.4.1b). Please note the Lead Agency has an approved waiver for this requirement through July 31, 2026. Overall Target Completion Date: 07/31/2026 Action Step Number Action Step Description Target Completion Date 1 Arkansas launched a new eligibility system 12/4/2024. 12/04/2024 2 Arkansas plans to finalize new Prospective payment and pay by enrollment policies by May 2025. 05/30/2025 3 We are working with our IT department to update the payment practice process. 07/31/2026
